bossMusic.name: Mordant's Shadow
bossMusic.note: Same lo-fi kit, a bit darker: C minor, a throbbing eighth-note bass, pushier kick, a filtered buzzy pad and a tense G7(b9) turnaround. A chapter can override with boss.music.

hint.name: Hint
hint.desc: Calls the floor's teacher back for a one-line nudge. (Using it costs the speed star.)

eliminate.name: Eliminate
eliminate.desc: Removes one wrong card from your hand and explains why it's wrong.

shield.name: Shield
shield.desc: Blocks the damage from your next mistake. A 33% chance it holds and keeps protecting you.

tutor.name: Tutor
tutor.desc: The floor's teacher answers this question and the next one for you, then explains every answer. Never sold: an 8% chance to drop each time you finish a question. (Tutored questions pay no card coins and cost the speed star.)

maxHeart.name: +1 Max Heart
maxHeart.desc: Start every level with one more heart (Normal and Exam).

mysteryPack.desc: A small surprise: a common or uncommon power card, a random cosmetic you don’t own yet (rarer ones are rarer!), or a few coins back.
